content:
jess: Quick probe — when we're comparing new ranker v2-int8, how are we sampling negatives for the NDCG runs? I see big MRR variance depending on neg mix.

sam: Are you using synthetic negatives + BM25 hard negatives?

jess: currently yes: 1:3 ratio synthetic:hard. The issue: short queries get skewed. NDCG@10 up, MRR down.

lee: Do we have the sampling script used in the bench? can you paste header?

jess: here's the command we ran:
```
python bench/run_eval.py --dataset=prod_holdout --negatives=synthetic:3,hard:1 --seed=42 --quant=int8 --batch-size=64
```

maya: fwiw int8 run used quantized weights but fp16 KV cache; maybe mismatch between runtime and offline eval.

sam: interesting — if KV cache fp16 but weights int8, behavior could be nondeterministic across seeding/batching and cause top-1 jitter.

jess: suggestion: try stratified sampling by query length and doc length; also test exclusive hard-negatives sample (no synthetic).

lee: I'll spin a quick diff: stratify by query_len buckets [0-10,11-30,31+], keep same total sample size and seed.

eval-bot: job queued: bench/5043216800-stratified-sample-run (owner: lee)

maya: Also add metrics . We should output NDCG@1/5/10, MRR, top1-swap-rate, and per-slice count + token length distributions. Log candidate ordering snapshots for failing queries.

sam: Agree. Also include tokenization variant column: whitespace vs casefolded BPE vs cased. Might expose tokenizer-induced ties.

jess: ok plan. Lee, can you include the run configs in the PR and pin seeds/batch sizes and runtime env (kv_cache_dtype)?

lee: will do. Draft PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/1234 — I added the stratified sampler and a small harness to dump candidate orders for top-5.

jess: thanks — if stratified run reduces MRR gap we likely had sample bias. If not, next step is calibration/rescale (per-query score rescaling between fp16/int8) and a controlled ablation on KV dtype.

maya: one more ask: can we run one toy experiment with only long-queries (>30) but using exclusive hard negatives? That isolates the effect for long-tail.

lee: queued that as bench/5043216810-long-only-hardneg. I'll report back in this thread with numbers.

jess: perfect. quick checklist: ensure seeds, batch-size, kv_cache_dtype in manifest; store candidate-order dumps; include per-slice ndcg/mrr csv.

sam: thanks everyone.
